articles.headline: Nvidia price hike is set to raise IT costs for enterprise buyers
articles.summary: Analysts say a coming Nvidia price increase will lift costs for companies buying AI infrastructure, not just those expanding large-scale AI deployments. That matters for budgeting because it can affect server refresh plans, cloud economics, and total cost of ownership across enterprise IT stacks.

articles.headline: Salesforce broadens Anthropic integration as enterprise AI competition deepens
articles.summary: Salesforce and Anthropic are expanding their collaboration to connect Claude-style reasoning with enterprise workflows and data. For businesses, this points to a stronger push toward embedded AI in CRM and operations, with implications for productivity, vendor lock-in, and software purchasing decisions.

articles.headline: McKinsey says enterprise AI gains are real, but costs remain a major hurdle
articles.summary: McKinsey reports that AI is finally delivering measurable enterprise benefits, but the gap between individual productivity gains and organization-wide impact remains significant because costs are still high. That is especially relevant for leaders evaluating whether AI pilots will scale into durable operating savings.
